name: Manolo Blahnik
band_note: shoe house, banded on shoe entry $875 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's pumps, mules, sandals and bridal shoes, mostly $1,000–1,500 (Hangisi $1,450), plus bags and men's shoes, sold through its own boutiques, site and department stores.
origin: Founded in London, United Kingdom in 1970 by Manolo Blahnik.

ownership.owner: Manolo Blahnik International Limited (privately owned, family run)

quote.q: Manolo still sketches every shoe himself and works with his niece to bring the collection to fruition.

opview: “Manolo still sketches every shoe himself and works with his niece to bring the collection to fruition.” — Manolo Blahnik (house), The Company, manoloblahnik.com

facts_read.source: brand site; nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

doors.note: US: 3 own doors, the 'Flagship Boutiques' — 717 Madison Ave, New York 10065; 140 NE 39th St Suite 111, Miami 33137; South Coast Plaza Suite 1231, Costa Mesa 92626. World: 159 locator rows in 20 countries; 19 flagged as flagship boutiques and 15 as shop-in-shops, none of the shop-in-shops in the US. The other 64 US rows are stockists (Neiman Marcus x26, Nordstrom x14, Saks x4, Bergdorf Goodman and boutiques) in return_stockists.csv. London label.

craft_evidence.owned: claim only — 'the artisans in our Italian factory' (Archives, The Craft room); factory not named or placed on the brand's site
craft_evidence.mills: no — PDPs give leathers by type (lamb nappa, calf, kid), no tannery named
craft_evidence.madein: 100% (12 of 12 sampled women's PDPs: Made in Italy)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed — founded 1970, boutique on Old Church Street, Chelsea; first US store 1979; family-run (Evangelina 1981, Kristina CEO 2013)
craft_evidence.process: thin — PDPs give upper/sole/lining materials and heel height; Archives 'The Craft' room is an interactive experience whose text beyond a quote could not be read
craft_evidence.reasoning: Every sampled shoe says Made in Italy and lists upper, sole and lining leathers, and the founding story is dated and placed (1970, Chelsea). The brand speaks of 'our Italian factory' but never names or shows it on its own site, and no maker or tannery is named, so this is a country-plus-heritage 2 on the evidence; a named factory would lift it.
